# Glossary

**ADT (Antibody-Derived Tag)** — Nucleotide-barcode-tagged antibody binding a surface protein; ADT count proxies protein abundance (Ch 10).

**AIR (Adaptive Immune Receptor)** — TCR (αβ/γδ) or BCR (heavy+light chain); generated by V(D)J recombination (Ch 11).

**AnnData** — Python data structure for annotated single-cell matrices; `.X` (counts) + `.obs` (cell metadata) + `.var` (gene metadata) + `.obsm` (embeddings) + `.layers` (alternative representations) + `.uns` (unstructured) (Ch 1).

**AUCell** — Area Under Recovery Curve; scores regulon activity per cell by how highly regulon genes rank in expression (Ch 6).

**Batch effect** — Technical confounders causing dataset distribution shifts; must be removed (Harmony, scVI, BBKNN) before biological analysis (Ch 3).

**BCR** — B-cell receptor; undergoes somatic hypermutation (~10,000× germline rate) requiring distance-based clonotype definition (Dandelion) (Ch 11).

**Bundle** — Cluster of cells with shared gene expression; primary unit of clustering analysis (Ch 3).

**CDR3** — Complementarity-determining region 3; most variable portion of AIR, primary antigen contact site (Ch 11).

**Chain pairing (scirpy)** — Classification of AIR status: single pair / orphan VJ / orphan VDJ / extra chain / multichain (doublet) (Ch 11).

**Chromatin accessibility** — Openness of chromatin regions measured by scATAC-seq; ~2% genome accessible per cell type (Ch 8).

**Clonotype** — Cells descending from one V(D)J recombination event; defined by identical CDR3 (strict) or sequence distance (relaxed) (Ch 11).

**CLR (Centered Log-Ratio)** — ADT normalization: count / geometric_mean(cell) → log; depth-only correction (Ch 10).

**Compositional data** — Cell-type proportions that sum to 1; standard stats invalid; requires scCODA (Dirichlet-multinomial with reference cell type) (Ch 5).

**Doublet** — Two cells captured in one droplet; barcode has mixed RNA. Detected via scDblFinder (RNA), AMULET (ATAC), CD3+CD19+ markers (ADT) (Ch 2, 8, 10).

**dsb (denoised and scaled by background)** — ADT normalization using empty droplets (ambient correction) + isotype controls (non-specific binding correction); preferred over CLR (Ch 10).

**FASTQ** — Sequencing read format (4-line: identifier, sequence, optional, quality); input to alignment + UMI counting (Ch 1).

**HVG (Highly Variable Gene)** — Genes with high variance across cells; selected via seurat_v3, cellranger, or deviance; used for PCA + clustering (Ch 2).

**Harmony** — Batch correction algorithm; iterates soft clustering + linear correction; works on PCA embeddings for RNA/ADT (Ch 3, 10).

**Heterotypic doublet** — Doublet of two different cell types; detectable via mutually exclusive markers (CD3+CD19+) (Ch 10).

**Leiden** — Community detection algorithm on kNN graph; resolution parameter controls cluster granularity (lower = coarser) (Ch 3).

**Ligand activity (NicheNet)** — AUPR of ligand-target regulatory potential vs observed DE geneset; higher = ligand better predicts response (Ch 6).

**Ligand-receptor inference** — CellPhoneDB/LIANA; computes mean ligand-receptor expression + permutation p-value; answers "is the interaction plausible?" (Ch 6).

**MAD (Median Absolute Deviation)** — Robust outlier metric used for QC: `is_outlier(M, metric, nmads)` flags cells > nmads from median (Ch 2).

**Marker gene** — Gene specifically expressed in one cell type; used for manual annotation (CD3=T, CD19=B, CD14=Monocyte) (Ch 3).

**Moran's I** — Spatial autocorrelation metric; detects SVGs (spatially variable genes); range [-1, 1], 0 = random (Ch 9).

**MuData** — Multimodal extension of AnnData; `.mod` dict of modalities (rna, prot, atac) + global `.obs`/`.var` (Ch 1, 12).

**NicheNet** — Intracellular signaling inference; ligand activity from regulatory potential vs DE geneset; answers "does the ligand explain the response?" (Ch 6).

**Pseudobulk** — Aggregating single cells per sample+cell type before DE; avoids pseudo-replication, enables PyDESeq2/limma (Ch 5).

**Pseudotime** — Latent 1D ordering of cells along a trajectory; reflects progression through transitions (Ch 4).

**Regulon** — TF + its set of target genes; activity scored per cell by AUCell (Ch 6).

**Repertoire overlap** — Jaccard distance between sample clonotype sets; hierarchical clustering groups similar repertoires (Ch 11).

**RNA velocity** — Rate of expression change inferred from unspliced/spliced mRNA ratio; steady-state (scVelo) or EM (dynamical) model (Ch 4).

**scANVI** — Semi-supervised scVI variant; uses cell-type labels during training for better anchor-based integration (Ch 3, 12).

**scIB metrics** — Benchmarking suite: Bio conservation (ASW_label, NMI, ARI, isolated_label_silhouette, cLISI) + Batch correction (ASW_label/batch, PCR_batch, graph_conn, iLISI, kBET); Overall = 0.6·Bio + 0.4·Batch (Ch 3, 12).

**scirpy** — scverse extension for AIRR analysis; stores AIR data in `adata.obs` columns (`IR_VJ_1_*`, `IR_VDJ_1_*`) (Ch 11).

**scVI** — Single-cell Variational Inference; conditional VAE with ZINB distribution; raw counts input; batch key as condition (Ch 3, 12).

**Seurat** — R single-cell toolkit; default for ADT (WNN integration), reference mapping (anchor-based) (Ch 3, 10).

**Spectratype** — Distribution of CDR3 amino-acid lengths; peaks indicate immunodominant lengths (often 15 aa for TCRβ) (Ch 11).

**Somatic hypermutation (SHM)** — BCR-only; ~10,000× germline mutation rate in V-gene during affinity maturation (Ch 11).

**Spatial domain** — Spatially-coherent tissue region; detected via SpaGCN (graph + CNN) or STAGATE (graph + autoencoder) (Ch 9).

**TCR** — T-cell receptor; CDR3β dominates specificity; importance ranking: CDR3β > V/J-gene > CDR3α > MHC > cell type (Ch 11).

**TCRdist** — BLOSUM-based distance metric using all CDRs; cutoff 120 = same specificity cluster (Ch 11).

**TotalVI** — multimodal VAE for RNA+ADT; denoises + integrates CITE-seq; uses shared latent space (Ch 12).

**Trajectory inference** — Computational ordering of cells by similarity to recover dynamic processes; DPT, Palantir, PAGA (Ch 4).

**UMI (Unique Molecular Identifier)** — Per-molecule barcode; enables PCR duplicate removal; basis for UMI counting in scRNA-seq (Ch 1).

**VDJ recombination** — Somatic assembly of V-(D)-J gene segments creating adaptive immune receptor diversity (Ch 11).

**WNN (Weighted Nearest Neighbors)** — Seurat v4 multimodal integration; per-cell modality weights + joint kNN graph (Ch 12).

## Tool Ecosystem Glossary (Ch 13-17)

**AMULET** - scATAC-seq doublet detection; counts genomic positions with >2 overlapping fragments (impossible for singlet diploid); catches homotypic doublets missed by scDblFinder (Ch 14).

**ArchR** - R scATAC-seq suite; HDF5-backed; >1M cells; most features including doublet detection, peak calling, trajectory (Ch 14).

**awesome-single-cell (seandavi)** - GitHub curated catalog of single-cell tools, databases, tutorials; the canonical entry point for tool discovery (Ch 17).

**BandNorm** - scHi-C distance-centric normalization; regresses out dominant distance-decay signal; outperforms bulk ICE/KR on single cells (Ch 15).

**BANKSY** - Spatial domain method; unifies cell typing and tissue segmentation by constructing product space of cell's own and microenvironment transcriptomes (Ch 16).

**Baysor** - Stain-free cell segmentation for subcellular spatial transcriptomics (Xenium, MERFISH); uses transcript density (Ch 16).

**Cell2location** - Bayesian spatial deconvolution; best-in-class for spot-based spatial; needs scRNA reference (Ch 16).

**CellBender** - Deep learning ambient RNA correction for scRNA-seq; GPU-accelerated (Ch 13).

**CellChat** - Cell-cell communication inference; shiny app available; one of several CCC methods (Ch 13).

**CellPhoneDB** - Ligand-receptor plausibility inference; permutation-based; one of L-R methods (Ch 13, 06).

**Cellpose** - Deep learning cell segmentation for imaging-based spatial transcriptomics (Ch 16).

**CellTypist** - Logistic regression cell type annotation with pretrained models (Immune_All_Low/High, etc.); part of Teichmann lab (Ch 13).

**cisTopic** - LDA-based topic modeling for scATAC-seq; binarized matrix -> cell topics + region topics (Ch 14).

**chromVAR** - scATAC-seq per-cell TF activity via deviation scores; background = all peaks with motif (Ch 14).

**CosMx (Nanostring)** - Imaging-based subcellular spatial transcriptomics; ~1000 gene panel (Ch 16).

**Curio Seeker** - Commercial Slide-seq platform; ~10μm beads (Ch 16).

**CZ CELLxGENE Census** - Standardized scRNA-seq census; >33M cells, >60K genes; Python/R API via `cellxgene-census` (Ch 17).

**Dip-C** - Diploid chromatin conformation capture; haplotype-resolved; ~5x more contacts than bulk scHi-C (Ch 15).

**DORC (Domain of Regulatory Chromatin)** - Gene + correlated accessible peaks within ~200kb; used by FigR for GRN inference (Ch 14, 08).

**DoubletFinder** - R scRNA-seq doublet detection; simulated doublets + PCA + classification (Ch 13).

**FigR** - Paired RNA+ATAC GRN inference; cisTopic LDA -> DORC -> ChromVAR -> TF-DORC correlations (Ch 14, 08).

**Fast-Higashi** - scHi-C tensor decomposition (PARAFAC2); faster than Higashi; rare cell type identification (Ch 15).

**Giotto** - Spatial omics integrative analysis toolbox; R/Python (Ch 16).

**Harmony** - Fast batch correction on PCA embeddings; iterates soft clustering + linear correction (Ch 13, 03, 10).

**Higashi** - scHi-C hypergraph representation learning; imputation + clustering + cell embedding (Ch 15).

**hickit** - C toolkit for diploid scHi-C; TAD calling, phase imputation, 3D modeling (Ch 15).

**Human Cell Atlas (HCA)** - Global consortium; tissue-specific atlases; downloadable via CZ CELLxGENE (Ch 17).

**inferCNV** - Copy-number variation inference from scRNA-seq; relative expression vs reference (Ch 13).

**LIANA** - Consensus CCC framework; aggregates CellPhoneDB, NATMI, Connectome, SingleCellSignalR; `li.mt.rank_aggregate` (Ch 13, 06).

**Liger** - NMF-based multi-omics integration; R/Python; unpaired datasets (Ch 13, 12).

**MAESTRO** - End-to-end scRNA + scATAC pipeline; CCA-based integration (Ch 14).

**MERFISH** - Multiplexed error-robust FISH; imaging-based spatial; 100-1000 gene panel (Ch 16).

**Monocle3** - R trajectory inference; DDRTree dimensionality reduction; branching trajectories (Ch 13).

**NATMI** - Cell-cell communication; ligand-receptor mean expression + specificity (Ch 13).

**NicheNet** - Ligand activity inference; AUPR of ligand-target regulatory potential vs DE geneset (Ch 13, 06).

**nnSVG** - Nearest-neighbor Gaussian process SVG detection; scalable; handles covariates (Ch 16).

**Numbat** - Allele-aware CNV inference from scRNA-seq; phasing + allele-specific expression (Ch 13).

**OSCA (Orchestrating Single-Cell Analysis)** - Bioconductor book-format tutorial; R-based (Ch 17).

**OSTA (Orchestrating Spatially-resolved Transcriptomics Analysis)** - Bioconductor spatial tutorial; R-based (Ch 17).

**Palantir** - Multi-fate branching trajectory; marks terminal states; diffusion pseudotime + MSC Markov chain (Ch 13, 04).

**pipeComp** - Pipeline comparison framework; scRNA-seq preprocessing benchmark (Ch 17).

**PRECAST** - Probabilistic embedding, clustering, alignment for spatial transcriptomics integration (Ch 16).

**PyDESeq2** - Python port of DESeq2; bulk DE on pseudobulk counts; standard for scRNA DGE (Ch 13, 05).

**RCTD** - Robust decomposition of cell type mixtures; spatial deconvolution; R/BayesSpace (Ch 16).

**Scanorama** - Panorama-stitching inspired scRNA-seq integration; corrects batches via mutual nearest neighbors (Ch 13).

**scAI** - Integrative analysis of scRNA + scATAC/methylation; matrix factorization (Ch 14, 12).

**scArches** - Reference mapping with scVI/scANVI; query -> reference transfer + uncertainty (Ch 13, 03).

**scDblFinder** - R scRNA-seq doublet detection; simulated doublets + PCA + classification; recommended (Ch 13).

**SCENIC** - 3-step GRN inference: co-expression (GRNBoost) -> motif (cisTarget) -> AUCell; per-cell regulon activity (Ch 13, 06).

**SCENIC+** - End-to-end paired RNA+ATAC GRN inference; extends SCENIC to chromatin (Ch 14).

**scHiCExplorer** - Python scHi-C toolbox; processing -> normalization -> clustering -> compartment -> viz (Ch 15).

**scIB metrics** - Integration benchmarking suite; Bio (ASW_label, NMI, ARI, isolated_label, cLISI) + Batch (ASW_label/batch, PCR, graph_conn, iLISI, kBET); Overall = 0.6·Bio + 0.4·Batch (Ch 13, 17).

**scHiCluster** - scHi-C imputation + clustering; linear convolution + random walk with restarts (Ch 15).

**scOpen** - scATAC-seq imputation via regularized NMF; improves downstream cisTopic, chromVAR, Cicero (Ch 14).

**scSPRITE** - Single-cell split-pool recognition of interactions by tag extension; multi-way interactions (Ch 15).

**scVelo** - RNA velocity inference; dynamical mode preferred over steady-state (Ch 13, 04).

**Seurat v3/v4/v5** - R single-cell toolkit; anchors (v3), WNN (v4), multi-modal integration (v5); standard for ADT/CITE-seq (Ch 13, 10, 12).

**Signac** - Seurat extension for scATAC-seq; ChromatinAssay class; LSI + TF-IDF (Ch 14).

**SimpleDiff** - scHi-C differential contact analysis; Wilcoxon on distance-specific Z-score-transformed contacts (Ch 15).

**Slide-seq / Slide-seq v2** - Spatial transcriptomics; 10μm beads; commercialized as Curio Seeker (Ch 16).

**SnapATAC / SnapATAC2** - scATAC-seq pipeline; bin-based; SnapATAC2 = Rust+Python rewrite with matrix-free spectral clustering (Ch 14).

**SnapHiC / SnapHiC2** - scHi-C loop calling at 10kb; random walk imputation + paired t-test; SnapHiC2 = sliding window (Ch 15).

**SoupX** - R ambient RNA correction; estimates contamination from empty droplets (Ch 13).

**SpaGCN** - Spatial domain detection; graph + CNN; integrates histology image (Ch 16).

**SpatialDE / SpatialDE2** - Gaussian process SVG detection; handles covariates; SpatialDE2 = faster reimplementation (Ch 16).

**SpatialData** - scverse spatial data structure; extends AnnData with coordinates + images (Ch 16).

**SpatialExperiment** - Bioconductor spatial data structure; extends SingleCellExperiment (Ch 16).

**STAGATE** - Spatial domain detection; graph + autoencoder; denoises via spatial neighbors (Ch 16).

**Stereo-seq (BGI)** - Subcellular spatial transcriptomics; DNA nanoball-patterned arrays; large tissue (Ch 16).

**Tabula Muris / Tabula Sapiens** - Mouse / human multi-tissue scRNA-seq atlas; reference for annotation (Ch 17).

**Tangram** - Spatial transcriptomics imputation + deconvolution; optimal transport; maps scRNA to spatial (Ch 16).

**Visium / Visium HD** - 10x Genomics spatial; Visium = 55μm spots, Visium HD = 2μm bins (Ch 16).

**Voyager** - Bioconductor package; exploratory spatial data analysis for SpatialFeatureExperiment (Ch 16).

**WGCNA / scWGCNA** - Weighted gene co-expression network analysis; scWGCNA = meta-cell extension for single-cell (Ch 13).

**Xenium (10x)** - Imaging-based subcellular spatial transcriptomics; ~300-5000 gene panel (Ch 16).

**Zonation** - Spatial gradient of cell identities (e.g., liver lobule, intestinal crypt); identified via spatial domains (Ch 16).

## anndata & Scanpy API Glossary (Ch 18-24)

**accessor (`anndata.acc`, `A`)** - Global accessor that builds `AdRef` references to AnnData arrays (`A.X[:, "gene"]`, `A.obsm["pca"][:, 0]`); used for presence checks (`ref in adata`), extraction (`adata[ref]`), and Marsilea plotting (Ch 18, 24).

**AnnCollection / AnnCollectionView** - Lazy multi-file wrapper that jointly indexes multiple AnnData without copying `X`/`layers`; subsetting returns a `View`; `iterate_axis(n)` yields batches for out-of-core algorithms (Ch 20).

**annbatch.Loader** - Separate scverse package for PyTorch/JAX minibatch streaming from many AnnData; `chunk_size`/`batch_size`/`preload_to_gpu`; replaces deprecated `AnnLoader` (Ch 20).

**awkward array** - Ragged/nested data (e.g. per-gene transcript lists) in `layers`/`obsm`/`varm`/`uns`; experimental since anndata 0.9 (Ch 20).

**backed mode** - `read_h5ad(path, backed="r")` keeps data on disk and loads on access; `isbacked`, `filename`, `file.close()` (Ch 18).

**BBKNN** - Batch-balanced kNN: builds the neighbor graph within each batch, then merges; symmetric graph-level integration that leaves `X` invariant (Ch 23).

**cell cycle scoring** - `sc.tl.score_genes_cell_cycle` (Tirosh 97 genes: 43 S + 54 G2M) adds `S_score`/`G2M_score`/`phase`; regress via `sc.pp.regress_out` (Ch 24).

**consolidated metadata** - zarr v3 stores write a `.zmetadata` by default; the store becomes immutable — mutate with `use_consolidated=False` then re-consolidate (Ch 19).

**dask-backed AnnData** - `X`/`obsm`/`layers` hold `da.Array` chunks (lazy, distributed); `to_memory()` materializes; scanpy dask support is experimental (Ch 20, 24).

**h5ad vs zarr** - Two AnnData on-disk formats sharing one self-describing layout: zarr (cloud-native, parallel, async, sharded) vs h5ad (single HDF5 file, serial). Prefer zarr for large/remote (Ch 19).

**ingest** - `sc.tl.ingest(adata, adata_ref, obs=...)` maps labels+embeddings from an annotated reference to query via PCA + neighbor search; asymmetric (like scmap/MNN) (Ch 23).

**layers / obsm / varm / obsp / varp / raw** - AnnData slots: `layers` = same-shape alt matrices (raw counts), `obsm`/`varm` = per-cell/gene multi-dim (`X_umap`, `PCs`), `obsp`/`varp` = pairwise graphs (`connectivities`), `raw` = pre-normalization snapshot (Ch 18).

**marsilea** - Compositional plotting library; builds figures from plotters on an AnnData via the `A` accessor; `+`/`/` combine boards; `render()` last (Ch 24).

**merge strategies (`ad.concat`)** - `None`/`same`/`unique`/`first`/`only` control how non-concat-axis elements and nested `uns` combine (Ch 20).

**PAGA** - Partition-based Graph Abstraction: coarse-grained cluster connectivity graph; `threshold` prunes weak edges; feeds DPT and PAGA-initialized embeddings (Ch 24).

**Pearson residuals** - Analytic normalization that removes depth technical variation, stabilizes mean-variance, and amplifies DE genes (residual variance >1); `sc.experimental.pp` (Lause 2021); output is **dense** (Ch 24).

**rank_genes_groups** - One-vs-rest marker test per cluster (`method="wilcoxon"`); results in `uns`, flattened by `sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df`; per-cell p-values are pseudoreplication-inflated (Ch 23).

**read_lazy / read_elem_lazy** - `anndata.experimental` lazy readers returning dask-backed `X` + lazy `obs`/`var` (`Dataset2D`); `load_annotation_index=True` skips index load; `to_memory()` for scanpy (Ch 19).

**sc.pp / sc.tl / sc.pl** - Scanpy's three modules: preprocessing (matrix transforms), tools (named annotations), plotting (mirrors `tl`); functions mutate `adata` in place and return `None` (Ch 21).

**sc.get / sc.queries / sc.metrics** - Satellite modules: extract results as DataFrames (`rank_genes_groups_df`, `aggregate`), annotation queries (`mitochondrial_genes`, `enrich`), evaluation (`morans_i`, `gearys_c`, `confusion_matrix`) (Ch 22).

**view vs copy (AnnData)** - Subsetting returns a zero-copy *view*; copy-on-modify detaches it; `.copy()` materializes a real object (Ch 18).

**write compatibility profile (`compat`)** - Every write function takes `compat="0.13"` (or a `WriteConfig`): the oldest anndata version guaranteed to read every element; `unwriteable()` checks without writing (Ch 19).
